verdicts.reason: A fills the taller canvas sensibly, with a large phone, a strong headline and a prominent CTA. Its flaws: the badge and CTA are crowded into the lower-right corner, the CTA sits close to the bottom edge, and the phone almost touches the top and bottom. B pins the phone and text to the top and leaves a dead empty band across the bottom half. Its cream circle looks clipped and ragged, and the small 'Online Only' badge hangs awkwardly under the CTA, so the layout looks unbalanced and top-heavy.
